fields.title: Express Tribune article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields parsed from a NewsArticle ld+json block plus the article body HTML. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link-style fields derived from the sitemap, with no article body. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so field values may occasionally be null or missing on a CMS quirk.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value that produced this record: the article URL in article mode, or the literal string 'latest' in latest mode.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, e.g. 'S1-html[express-parent-div]' or 'S1-html[custom-row]' for article mode (named after the body-container template found), 'S2-sitemap' for latest mode, or 'none' on a failed extraction.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from NewsArticle ld+json 'headline' (article mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Article summary/description, from NewsArticle ld+json 'description' (article mode only).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, extracted from the page's body container (div.express-parent-div or, as a fallback, div.custom-row) as paragraphs joined by blank lines. Boilerplate paragraphs (comment prompts, copyright notice, 'Read More:' related-article links) are filtered out (article mode only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article author name, from NewsArticle ld+json 'author.name' (article mode only).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name, from NewsArticle ld+json 'publisher.name' (article mode only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Publication date/time, from NewsArticle ld+json 'datePublished' (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Last-modified date/time, from NewsArticle ld+json 'dateModified' (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Article image URL(s), from NewsArticle ld+json 'image' -- may be a string or an array depending on upstream shape (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Readable title derived from the URL slug (last path segment, hyphens replaced with spaces, title-cased) -- cosmetic only, not the real headline (latest mode only).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the sitemap's <loc> element (latest mode only).

lastmod.title: Last modified
lastmod.description: Sitemap <lastmod> value for this URL, if present (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
